marketing_wrapper: All six share one template: a black two-line caption on near-white (#fafafa) in the top ~18%, then a white-rimmed phone frame with no bezel detail, sitting on a soft pastel wash (pink/lilac/peach in 01, 02, 04; lilac-blue in 03, 05; sky blue in 06). The frame is cropped at the bottom, so real UI is ~65% of each image. Every image is a real chat screen; no lock-screen or pure-art frames. None shows the Nov 2026 Home/Explore tab bar.

typography.display: Captions and UI share one geometric-humanist sans with a round O and single-storey feel at display sizes, consistent with OpenAI Sans; there is no in-app display title (the top bar has no title)
typography.body: custom, very likely OpenAI Sans / unsure on exact cut
typography.numerals: proportional (prices '€6', '52 BCE', '508 CE' in running text)
typography.weights: Regular body for both user and assistant text; bold only for inline markdown (list item leads, section labels 'Starters', prices in 05); captions medium
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case throughout; default tracking; captions slightly tight

palette.accent_strategy: One accent, iOS system blue: the filled voice button in the composer and the blue text inside pale-blue user bubbles. The only other colour is the periwinkle-to-white voice orb in 02. Assistant text is plain black on white with no bubble.
palette.source: palette.json 01–06: #ffffff 24–38% = app canvas; #fafafa / #fbfbfb 19–22% = caption band; #c9aaa8, #d2c5d3, #dbc3dc, #e3e8f7, #bdeafb = marketing pastel backdrops. Pixel samples: voice button #0279ff (03 at 446,1130), user bubble #e9f2ff and bubble text ~#608dd0 (03), orb #7d81fe–#a0b3ff (02). Text is near-black; JPEG sampling bottoms at #000000.

shape.radius_language: pill and large: full-pill composer (~28pt), circular icon buttons, user bubbles ~20pt with a pill feel on one line, generated images ~16pt
shape.borders_shadows: No borders; floating top buttons and composer carry a very soft diffuse shadow; no dividers between turns
shape.materials: Flat white canvas; floating white controls over content (composer floats over the image in 01 with a fade under it)

liquid_glass_visible: unclear, leaning yes: the top-left circular menu button, the compose/more capsule and the floating pill composer are detached and shadowed over content, which matches iOS 26 glass placement, but on white no tint or refraction is readable.
density: low: one message column with ~24pt gaps between turns, a 6-icon action row under each answer, large empty areas under short answers (03)
layout: Thread-only: no title in the top bar, right-aligned blue user bubbles, left-aligned bubble-less assistant prose with an action row (copy, speak, thumbs up/down, regenerate, share), floating composer at bottom. Rich content (generated images, markdown menus) inline.
navigation: Top-left circular hamburger (drawer) and a top-right capsule grouping new-chat and overflow; 02 swaps the capsule for a sliders button during voice. No tab bar visible in any screenshot. Composer: + (tools sheet), 'Ask ChatGPT' placeholder, mic (dictation), filled blue voice button.
imagery_and_icons: Outline monoline icon set (custom-looking, close to SF Symbols weight) for all chrome and action rows; photography only as user content and generated images.
signature_visual_move: Pure white thread where the only colour is the system-blue voice button and the blue-tinted user bubbles.
tells_present: Gestalt sameness: 'they all look the same' (it is the template the others share)

direction_fit.why: White canvas, one sans, one pill composer, bubble-less assistant text and a single system-blue accent are exactly the archetype the text record names. One correction: the text record expected a 'pulsating blue disc'; the visible orb is periwinkle-to-white, and the composer's accent is iOS system blue rather than an OpenAI brand colour.

notes: Composer: full pill, '+' left, 'Ask ChatGPT' placeholder, mic glyph, then a filled blue circle with a waveform glyph for voice; in voice mode (02) the composer shrinks to a short pill with + and a separate muted-mic circle and a black X close disc. Greeting/empty state: not shown in any screenshot. Voice: merged into the thread (02) as a soft periwinkle blob/orb floating above the composer while messages stay visible, matching the Nov 2025 voice-in-chat change. Thinking/streaming: not shown; answers appear fully rendered with an action row. Conversation list: not shown (drawer implied by the hamburger). The store set still shows the drawer-era chrome even though v1.2026.321 post-dates the Nov 19 2026 Home/Explore redesign, which is opt-in and staged; the screenshots cannot confirm the tab bar.
